cases.prompt: Assess whether verifiable site content can be discovered, understood, and cited by answer systems. Return sections Evidence, Result, and Next action; label fixture assumptions as verified for the simulation and distinguish them from unresolved real-world uncertainty.

sourceAnchors: Stop when verification would require bypassing access controls, automating prohibited queries, publishing unsupported facts, or treating one transient answer as a stable ranking.
